verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official OpenAPI-described REST API with SDKs (xero-node) that expose accounting data including Chart of Accounts and reports, and developer.xero.com hosts full API documentation. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms dedicated 'general ledger' or 'trial balance' report endpoints, or confirms open-format exports (CSV/JSON) of these specific reports. missing for 10: explicit documentation of general ledger/trial balance report endpoints, confirmation of export formats for these reports, independent developer confirmation of successfully pulling full GL/trial balance data via API.
